# Coforma Studio Full LLM Context

Generated: 2026-05-13 (curated 2026-10-01; kept by sync-agent-docs.py)

## Purpose

This file gives LLM agents a stable, tool-agnostic map for working in this
repository without depending on vendor-specific instruction files.

## Canonical instruction order

1. `AGENTS.md`
2. `README.md` if present
3. `ECOSYSTEM.md` if present
4. Relevant files under `docs/`, `infra/`, `.github/workflows/`, and source
   directories for the specific task

## Agent compatibility

`AGENTS.md` is the source of truth. `CLAUDE.md` exists only to redirect Claude
and other legacy agent integrations to `AGENTS.md`.

## Enclii-first operations contract

Use Enclii web, API, or CLI for routine production provisioning, deployment,
observability, domain management, secrets, provider operations, scaling,
rollback, and remediation.

Raw `kubectl`, `helm`, SSH, provider CLIs/APIs, `docker exec`, and direct
container access are allowed only for platform bootstrap or documented
break-glass emergencies when Enclii is unavailable or lacks an implemented
adapter. Any break-glass use must record the actor, reason, target
service/environment, commands executed, result, and follow-up Enclii adapter
gap or incident link.

- `README.md`

- `docs/`

- `.github/workflows/`

## Current state (verified 2026-10-01)

- Stack: Next.js 15.5.27 (App Router) and tRPC 10.45.4 in `packages/web`;
  NestJS + Prisma in `packages/api`; Postgres with row-level security per
  tenant.
- Dependencies: #144 brought `pnpm audit --prod` to 0 critical / 2 high
  (`postcss` 8.4.31, pinned exactly by `next`).
- Deploy: in-repo `build-deploy.yml` builds only the web image, pushes it to
  `ghcr.io/madfam-org/coforma-studio/web`, signs it with cosign, commits
  `deploy(web): pin digest ... [skip ci]` to
  `infra/k8s/production/kustomization.yaml`, and Argo CD reconciles. It runs on
  every push to `main` except `**.md`/`docs/**` changes; a manual dispatch
  needs `deploy_ack=production`. The api and admin manifests are not in the
  kustomization.
- Runners: CI is pinned to `ubuntu-24.04` (#145); the deploy job uses ARC when
  bootstrapped, else `ubuntu-24.04`.
- CI gates: NetworkPolicy port lint, ESLint (web advisory, #113), Prettier
  (advisory, #114), typecheck, build, vitest per package after test-database
  migrations, and Trivy. The root `tests/api/*.test.ts` live-server tests and
  the web Playwright suite do not run in CI.
- Backlog: Next image optimizer still on (`images.domains` plus a
  `**.r2.dev` wildcard; the fleet posture is `images.unoptimized: true` with an
  exact allow-list). Janua session verification uses a shared secret, not
  JWKS. Dhanam billing is not integrated.

## Related repositories / contracts

- Janua integration: https://github.com/madfam-org/janua/blob/main/docs/guides/ECOSYSTEM_INTEGRATION.md
- PhyndCRM (receiver of `x-madfam-signature` events): https://github.com/madfam-org/phynd-crm/blob/main/README.md
- PhyndCRM engagement events: https://github.com/madfam-org/phynd-crm/blob/main/docs/ENGAGEMENT_EVENT_TAXONOMY.md
- Tulana PMF webhook `/v1/pmf/coforma-event` (the Tulana repository is not
  public).

## Maintenance

These files are maintained by `internal-devops/scripts/sync-agent-docs.py`,
which keeps curated llms files untouched.
If repo-specific long-form agent guidance is needed, put it in `AGENTS.md`,
not `CLAUDE.md`.
